sentences.text: Billie Joe Armstrong -LRB- born February 17 , 1972 -RRB- is an American musician , singer , songwriter and actor who is best known as the lead vocalist , primary songwriter , and guitarist of the punk rock band Green Day , which he co-founded with Mike Dirnt .	Green Day	Green Day	punk rock	punk rock	Mike Dirnt	Mike Dirnt

He is also a guitarist and vocalist for the punk rock band Pinhead Gunpowder and provides lead vocals for Green Day 's side projects Foxboro Hot Tubs and The Network .	Green Day	Green Day	Pinhead Gunpowder	Pinhead Gunpowder	The Network	The Network	Foxboro Hot Tubs	Foxboro Hot Tubs	punk rock	punk rock
Raised in Rodeo , California , Armstrong developed an interest in music at a young age , and recorded his first song at the age of five .

He met Mike Dirnt while attending elementary school , and the two instantly bonded over their mutual interest in music , forming the band Sweet Children when the two were 15 years old .	Mike Dirnt	Mike Dirnt
The band changed its name to Green Day , and would later achieve massive commercial success .	Green Day	Green Day
Armstrong has also pursued musical projects outside of Green Day 's work , including numerous collaborations with other musicians .	Green Day	Green Day

In 1997 , to coincide with the release of Nimrod , Armstrong founded Adeline Records in Oakland to help support other bands releasing music and signed bands such as The Frustrators , AFI and Dillinger Four .	Adeline	Adeline Records	Nimrod	Nimrod (Green Day album)	Adeline Records	Adeline Records	The Frustrators	The Frustrators	AFI	AFI (band)	Dillinger Four	Dillinger Four
The record company has since come under the management of Pat Magnarella .
